THESE APPEALS, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT
There is no representation on behalf of the appellants.
2. Sri Rajkumar Korwar, learned High Court Government Pleader for respondents is present.
3. Accompanied applications with the appeals are to condone the delay of several days in filing all these appeals.

This Court on 03.11.2023 noted the absence of learned counsel for the appellants,
however, in order to afford an opportunity matter stood adjourned to next date.
The appeals are of the years 2014 and 2021.
4. It appears the appellants are not interested in prosecuting the appeals, hence, this Court has no option except NC: 2024:KHC-K:3329 to dismiss the appeals for non-prosecution.
Accordingly, the appeals are dismissed for non-prosecution.
